column1: # Reading pages (/ebooks/<book>/text/<file>), rebuilt like the tables of
# contents in manifest.tsv by the site's own deploy transform at each book's
# deployed commit, since robots.txt asks AI agents not to fetch them.
# 36 pages across 31 books: first, middle and last entries; chapters of
# novels, short stories, a whole play, a whole book of poems in one file, a
# divider page that is only "Book I", dividers carrying an epigraph or a
# paragraph, a dedication with no heading, and headings carrying a note
# content_chars is the whitespace-collapsed visible text of the page's
# <main>, and heading_number the arabic or roman number its heading prints
# first (after "Chapter", if that is printed; blank when it opens with
# anything else) — both measured by a separate bs4/lxml script, NOT by
# Extractor, so the tests cross-check the parser rather than echo it.
